    📲 Order on WhatsApp & How to Pay

    Make your own order right here on this website — pick your items, then send the order straight to the restaurant.

    1. Select your items on this page (or fill the booking form), then tap “Order My Selected Order on WhatsApp”. Your order opens in WhatsApp — press Send.
    2. The restaurant confirms your order on WhatsApp — the total bill and the delivery or pickup time.
    3. Pay the way the restaurant confirms. They will share their own payment details on WhatsApp (for example cash on delivery or a mobile payment). Only pay on the details the restaurant itself sends you in that chat — never pay anyone else.
    4. Send your payment screenshot / receipt on the same WhatsApp chat to confirm your payment, and keep the chat until your order arrives.
    📞 Call — 0316-6482308 💬 WhatsApp — 0321-7597629

    WhatsApp: if the button opens a chat, send the order there. If a number is not on WhatsApp, please use the Call button instead.
